text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- In meeting with members of Israeli parliament, Crown Prince Hassan urges Jordanian-Israeli-Palestinian economic cooperation.
- Eight Lebanese on way home after visiting religious sites in Iraq injured in traffic accident along Rwaished road close to Jordanian-Iraqi border.
- Britain's Minister of State with special responsibilities for Middle East, Jeremy Hanley, visits Jordan on Monday for talks with senior officials.
- Crown Prince and Prime Minister Kabariti stress to Israeli parliamentary delegation importance of implementing peace accords with Palestinians and pushing peace process on all fronts.
